description: This Java class 'PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter' customizes JSON writing by prettifying JSON with indentation and special handling for empty objects and arrays (producing '{}' and '[]' respectively). It extends 'JsonWriter' and includes nested classes for handling JSON objects and arrays with specific formatting conventions. The class provides configuration for indentation style and manages nested JSON structures through a stack of writer states.

classes.name: PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter
classes.description: A custom JSON writer that outputs JSON with pretty printing, handling empty objects and arrays as '{}' and '[]' respectively.

classes.name: PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter.AbstractJsonWriter
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common JSON writing functionality for nested writer classes, such as handling indentation.

classes.name: PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter.GeneralJsonWriter
classes.description: A concrete subclass of 'AbstractJsonWriter' that delegates array and object opening to dedicated inner classes.

classes.name: PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter.JsonObjectWriter
classes.description: Handles JSON object writing, ensuring empty objects are written as '{}', managing nested objects.

classes.name: PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter.JsonArrayWriter
classes.description: Handles JSON array writing, ensuring empty arrays are written as '[]', managing nested arrays.

methods.name: PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter.indentWithSpaces
methods.description: Creates a 'WriterConfig' that produces a 'PrettyPrintEmptyElementsWriter' with specified spaces for indentation.
